note: The Direct BeginRetiring route (DCLTDBR1) on five REAL role ELFs under solana-program-test: one top-level execution that retires the Direct child root, its replay, five hostile frames and the not-Retiring prestate boundary. WHY THIS CAMPAIGN EXISTS: the route executed against the real Trading ELF in a green four-test binary and was NEVER-EXECUTED to the census the whole time, because no bindings.json named it. The gap was the campaign wrapper, never the route -- the same finding tools/gauntlet/direct-fee-pair/ was written for, one binary along, and the producer needed no change at all: every submission already goes through `submit_v0_observed` -> `record_campaign_transaction`, which records when DCLUTCH_PROGRAM_TEST_EVIDENCE_DIR is set and stays silent when it is not. EVERY ROW IS AUTHORED FROM FOLDED EVIDENCE, never from what the campaign ought to touch: the label is the libtest thread name plus that test's submission ordinal plus a disposition read back from the runtime. WHAT THE SHAPE OF THIS FILE SAYS OUT LOUD: six of the eight transactions refuse, and five of those six refuse with one code. `trading/TradingSbfError::Content` covers a malformed frame, a frame refused before any state is read, a frame refused after 33k CU of authentication, and a Market in the wrong phase -- four different accusations wearing one word. Only `Root` distinguishes itself. Trading is the sole program in every log; BeginRetiring drives no CPI.
